subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional append?: boolean on the existing write tool and use PR #77127 as the landing branch, or request a different append API or candidate branch?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but the durable model-facing tool API and choice between two open append-mode PRs are maintainer product decisions rather than deterministic repair work.

options.title: Approve append flag on this branch
options.body: Accept append?: boolean as the public write-tool shape and land #77127 after exact-head CI and owner review confirm the extra session-admission changes are intended.

options.title: Request a different append API
options.body: Ask the author to reshape the fix around a dedicated append tool or explicit mode contract before merge, preserving the same safety and serialization guarantees.

options.title: Choose the sibling PR instead
options.body: Use #102243 as the canonical landing path only after confirming it has equal or better safety, proof, and owner review, then close this PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Approve append flag on this branch
recommendation.body: Accept append?: boolean as the public write-tool shape and land #77127 after exact-head CI and owner review confirm the extra session-admission changes are intended.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is the durable write-tool API and canonical landing path, which aligns with recent agent runtime and tool-surface ownership history.
